about_the_game:
Get Ready!

Race across a variety of dynamic tracks, each designed to challenge your precision, reflexes, and strategy. With a bold and striking art style crafted by ICONIC GARAGE, every race feels like a visual spectacle—where speed meets style.

Compete Your Way

🔥 Time Attack – Beat the clock and set record-breaking lap times.
👻 Ghost Races – Challenge your own best times or race against ghost opponents to fine-tune your skills.
🌍 Multiplayer Madness – Take the competition online and race against real players in thrilling, skill-based matchups.

Customize. Tune. Dominate.

Your car, your rules! Fine-tune your vehicle’s settings to match your racing style and the demands of each track. Whether it’s adjusting suspension for off-road grip, optimizing aerodynamics for high-speed circuits, or tweaking handling for tight corners, every setting can be the key to victory.

Choose from a diverse lineup of cars, each designed for different terrains and racing disciplines. Master every map, discover hidden achievements, and prove you have what it takes to be the fastest on the road!

Makes good 'ol racing great again! CARCADE!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP/Vista/7/8 or 10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz Intel Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 compatible video card with at least 1024MB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: CARCADE is a fast-paced racing game with a bold art style by ICONIC GARAGE. Compete in time trials, race against ghost opponents, AI, or real players. Tune your car for different terrains, master hidden mechanics, and unlock secret achievements. Speed, strategy, and skill will define your victory!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
